title: Sparse Convexification for High-Dimensional Constrained Regression
summary: We study high-dimensional linear regression under a general symmetric convex constraint. Rather than imposing a specific sparsity-inducing penalty, we start from an arbitrary sign-symmetric and permutation-invariant convex body $K\subseteq \mathbb R^p$ and construct the sparse convexification hierarchy \[ K^{(s)} = \operatorname{conv}\{v\in K:\|v\|_0\le s\}. \] We propose a penalized least-squares estimator that searches over this hierarchy and adapts to the best sparse convex approximation of the target.
